articles.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.

articles.title: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia’s tokenized stock volume
articles.snippet: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.

articles.title: Google Gives Gemini Control of Mac Apps, But Its New AI Agent Comes With Risks
articles.snippet: Gemini's new Mac computer-use feature navigates apps, files, and websites in a separate window, but Google's own documentation warns about prompt injection.

articles.title: GameStop CEO Says Digital-Only Games Have ‘Hurt Consumers’ as GTA 6 Skips Discs
articles.snippet: Ryan Cohen said publishers are cutting out trade-ins, as he backs a U.S. bill that would guarantee gamers keep access to games they buy.

articles.title: Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion
articles.snippet: The trader turned $300 into over $200,000 as early footage of GTA 6 sent degens flocking between different token tickers.
